rationale: The description only identifies a suite offering current versions of named desktop software tools and does not describe their functions.
evidence_spans: SAPIEN DevOps Suite offers current versions of all SAPIEN Technologies desktop software tools; PrimalScript, PowerShell Studio, VersionRecall, PrimalSQL, PrimalXML, PowerShell HelpWriter, WMI Explorer, and PowerShell ModuleManager.
conflict_response: Both proposals identify the same limitation: the text lists a suite and tool names but provides no tool behavior. Under the description-only rule, that support/license-like listing does not establish a substantive conventional function, so the weak forced non_ai judgment remains.
